cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.
